You are checking which candidate answer correctly answers a question about a SQL database.

Question:
Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT i.film_id, SUM(p.amount) as film_revenue
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
film_per_actor AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.actor_id,
        fr.film_id,
        fr.film_revenue,
        fr.film_revenue / COUNT(DISTINCT fa.actor_id) OVER (PARTITION BY fr.film_id) as per_actor_revenue
    FROM film_revenue fr
    JOIN film_actor fa ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        film_id,
        per_actor_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY per_actor_revenue DESC) as rn
    FROM film_per_actor
)
SELECT actor_id, film_id, ROUND(per_actor_revenue, 2) as per_actor_revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY actor_id, rn

SQL:
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        f.film_id,
        f.title,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
    FROM film f
    JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id
    JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
actor_film_stats AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        fa.actor_id,
        fr.film_id,
        fr.title,
        fr.total_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fa2.actor_id) OVER (PARTITION BY fr.film_id) as actor_count,
        fr.total_revenue / COUNT(DISTINCT fa2.actor_id) OVER (PARTITION BY fr.film_id) as avg_revenue_per_actor
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
    JOIN film_actor fa2 ON fr.film_id = fa2.film_id
    WHERE fr.total_revenue IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_films AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        film_id,
        title,
        total_revenue,
        avg_revenue_per_actor,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) as rank
    FROM actor_film_stats
)
SELECT 
    actor_id,
    title,
    total_revenue,
    avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked_films
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY actor_id, rank

        a.actor_id,
        a.first_name,
        a.last_name,

    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        film_id,
        title,
        revenue_per_actor,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY revenue_per_actor DESC) as rn
    FROM actor_film_revenue
)

    first_name,
    last_name,
    film_id,
    title,
    revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked_films
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY actor_id, revenue_per_actor DESC
